procedural_matters: FRA 1126 was represented by Hind Gaigi.
FRA 1307 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
Constance Jeanroy (crew of FRA 1126) attended the hearing as an observer.
The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident were 5.5 knots of wind and wavy.
FRA 1126 was sailing on a close-hauled course on starboard tack on the layline on the first upwind approaching the windward mark.
FRA 1307 was sailing close-hauled on port tack on a converging course with FRA 1126.
When FRA 1307 was about half a boat length away from FRA 1126, FRA 1126 luffed nearly head to wind.
Immediately after, FRA 1307 tacked onto starboard tack.
There was no contact, physical damage, or injury.
conclusions: FRA 1307 on port tack failed to keep clear of FRA 1126 on starboard tack, and broke RRS 10.
FRA 1126’s score in race 5 was not made worse by injury or physical damage. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(2) are not met.
